findings.quote: The king then decided the whole matter
findings.problem: Greek is ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ πᾶσιν: the king spoke last of all (after the others), not that he decided everything; the parenthetical εἰ χρὴ τοῦ βασιλέως λέγειν τὰς τότε γνώμας and the later ἐπικυρωθείσης ... τῆς γνώμης show the opinion was still to be ratified.
findings.proposed_fix: The king spoke last of all
